finding: The native LDBC smoke harness can create Q14 support indexes before command-mode workload execution.
evidence: The new --create-q14-indexes path compiles and runs FusionLdbcQ14Indexes, creating message(m_creatorid), message(m_c_replyof), and message(m_messageid) indexes before ldbc_command.
impact: BENCHPROD-110 profiler indexes are now available to native command-mode smoke runs.

finding: The first Q14-enabled native smoke reached LdbcQuery1 and exposed a nested array result-shape bug.
evidence: The run status was gap with ClassCastException: class [Ljava.lang.String; cannot be cast to class [[Ljava.lang.Object; while converting array_agg(ARRAY[o_name, year, place]).
impact: The remaining blocker was not Q14 weightedpaths timeout; it was projection dependency extraction for aggregate array expressions.

finding: Projection dependency extraction must recurse into Expr::Array elements.
evidence: After adding Expr::Array recursion, array_agg(ARRAY[...]) preserved nested values for SQL and PG protocol tests.
impact: Planner projection pushdown can remain enabled without corrupting nested array aggregate results.

finding: Q14-enabled native command-mode LDBC smoke passed after the array projection fix.
evidence: Summary status passed; reported operation count 19, duration 1.566 seconds, throughput 12.13 op/s, LdbcQuery14 count 1 at 1083 ms, and LdbcQuery1 count 1 at 116 ms.
impact: FusionDB now has native smoke evidence for Q14 enabled on the PostgreSQL implementation test-data path.

finding: Successful smoke stderr still reports missing LDBC PostgreSQL query/update SQL files.
evidence: Missing files include interactive-complex-3-duration-as-function.sql, interactive-complex-4-duration-as-function.sql, interactive-complex-7-with-second.sql, and multiple interactive-update SQL files.
impact: This must remain labeled as a native smoke pass, not a full official LDBC workload pass.

finding: LDBC installation hint text now reflects the current evidence boundary.
evidence: The hint now says full official coverage still needs missing PostgreSQL query/update SQL files and a broader operation mix to be proven.
impact: Future reports avoid overstating stale recursive blockers or overstating the Q14 smoke result.
